verdict.rationale: Morph ships its own official MCP server, which exposes edit_file and codebase_search to AI tools like Claude Code. The quickstart also has users install the Morph MCP so Claude Code can read it while setting up migrations. Together these let a user drive Morph's capabilities through natural-language requests in an agent. However, the product's own surface is an API, and there is no documented natural-language console or command interface for operating or managing Morph itself (keys, endpoints, canaries, Reflex training). missing for 10: first-party natural-language control of account and product management, documented natural-language operation beyond the MCP tool set, independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language-driven operation.
